parsed.post: Latest experiment improved val_bpb from 1.101 to 1.094. I suspect the lower val_bpb is due to better convergence, potentially hinting that we can handle a slightly higher learning rate or require a warmup. Next, I'll try adding a small warmup to stabilize higher learning rates.
parsed.description: Increase MATRIX_LR to 0.1 and introduce 5% WARMUP_RATIO to see if the improved signal from the last run can be further optimized.
